description: This source file defines an Android activity class 'Signature' which manages user interactions for capturing a signature, taking parcel pictures, uploading images, and updating job status within a logistics or delivery app. It includes methods for capturing and processing images, drawing on a view, uploading images via HTTP requests, and updating server-side data.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: An Android activity for capturing signatures, taking pictures of parcels, uploading images, and updating job delivery status within a delivery application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the signature activity, sets up UI components, event listeners, and drawing views.

methods.name: createImageFromSignature
methods.description: Captures the drawing as an image and proceeds to upload images.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Launches the device camera to take a picture of the parcel.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from camera intent, loads the captured image.

methods.name: uploadBitmap
methods.description: Uploads a bitmap image to the server via a multipart HTTP request.

methods.name: getFileDataFromDrawable
methods.description: Converts a Bitmap into a byte array for uploading.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as specified.

methods.name: updateDatabase
methods.description: Sends a request to update job status and associated images on the server.

methods.name: callUpdateDatabase
methods.description: Constructs image names and triggers the update of the job record in the database.

methods.name: createTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in external storage for storing captured images.

methods.name: grabImage
methods.description: Loads an image from the specified URI into a Bitmap and displays it.
